maturity.stable: Quality >= 80 (grade A/B), a11y-clean (no aria guidance needed), universally supported. Safe defaults.
maturity.beta: Solid but not yet stable: mid polish (quality 60–79) or needs author-side ARIA care. The default while earning stable.
maturity.experimental: Limited-engine support (scroll-driven animations) or unpolished (quality < 60). Use with care.

a11yTiers.motion-safe: The effect's own cssCode ships a prefers-reduced-motion guard (docs/EFFECT-A11Y-TIERS.md §2).
a11yTiers.motion-caution: No per-effect reduced-motion guard — covered by the global kill-switch in roycss.css; standalone copy-paste users may want their own guard.
